tools.name: get_athlete
tools.description: The rider's body settings (FTP, FTP history, max HR, weight, age in years, units), the dates of their first and last ride, the ride count and when the app last synced. ftp_history only holds FTPs a test replaced ("Use as FTP"); an FTP the rider typed in is not recorded there.

tools.name: list_rides
tools.description: The rider's rides, newest first: id, local start, duration, kJ, average and max power, average and max heart rate, kind (free, ramp, rampLite, edge, workout), the rider's effort rating (1-10, null if not rated). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the rider's local time, both inclusive. limit: 1-500, default 50

tools.name: get_ride
tools.description: One ride's full summary as the app computed it: stats (incl. normalized power), laps, power curve, power zones, left/right balance, pedal stroke and roundness (trainers measuring crank torque), heart rate, DFA-alpha1 per minute (experimental), the workout ridden, the FTP used, and the rider's effort

tools.name: get_ride_series
tools.description: A ride's second-by-second data averaged down to resolution_s (default 30; at most 720 points, so long rides get a coarser resolution). fields from: power, target, hr, cadence, right_pct, speed, distance, step. Default: power, hr, cadence. t_s is the start of each interval in recorded seconds.

tools.name: get_power_curve
tools.description: Best average power per duration (5 s to 60 min) over a period, with the ride each best came from. Dates YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; both optional (default: all rides).

tools.name: get_training_summary
tools.description: Per week (Monday-Sunday) for the last `weeks` weeks (default 8, max 104): rides, hours, kJ and seconds per power zone (Coggan 1-7, by each ride's FTP).

tools.name: list_workouts
tools.description: Every workout set as text: the rider's own (read-only for you) and each assistant's, with who wrote it. The workout format is in save_workout's description.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_rides" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the rider's local time, both inclusive. limit: 1-500, default 50.
